jobs-loop.start: Umer on a fresh crew on the stub engine, with a local posting page; no real model, account or job site
steps: Tell Chief the roles, places, pay floor and paste a CV; Chief shows one goal card with what the crew will do and a Won't do list
Say yes: the finder and the writer join, and the finder adds two roles from the posting page
Open Your goal from Jobs: the board with Found and Drafted columns, then open a Found role card
Tap Draft my application: the writer's draft card arrives with the only-you fields left empty
Tap I applied on the role and open Applied
Repeat the same screens in the installed app's window at phone size
jobs-loop.result: The goal card lists Won't do before anything starts. The board shows each role's place, pay as the posting says it, why it fits, what is missing and its source with the date checked; Found reads as plain information. The draft card keeps declarations, right to work, visa sponsorship, salary, notice and consent empty under Only you can answer these. Only Umer's own tap moves a role to Applied, which sets a 7-day follow-up. Nothing is submitted, sent or accepted. Not a real job site or a real model.

jobs-prep.start: Umer with a job search on the stub engine: a role he moved to Interview himself, and a local company page; no real model, account or job site
steps: Open Your goal from Jobs, the Interview column, and open the role card: it offers Prep for this interview
Tap it: the writer puts a company brief and the likely questions on the role; the card now offers Open your interview prep
Open the prep: the brief with each fact linked to the page it came from, then the likely questions each with why they ask it, and the fields only he answers left empty
Tap Practise with the interviewer: the writer's chat opens with the first question
Type an answer (the mic sits beside the box): the writer replies with what landed, what to tighten and an invitation to try again
Repeat the same screens in the installed app's window at phone size
jobs-prep.result: The prep reads as one page: every company fact shows the site it was read from as a link, each likely question says why it is asked, and the pay, visa, right-to-work, notice and consent fields are listed empty under Only you can answer these. The practice happens in the writer's chat, answered by typing or the mic; the reply gives what landed, what to tighten and an invitation to try again. Nothing is sent, filled in or signed, and no interviewer audio plays. Not a real company site or a real model.

jobs-apply.start: Umer with a job search on the stub engine: a role on the board and the writer's draft for it, and the writer's own browser (the pinned playwright-axi) on the posting's application form; the model's turns are scripted
steps: Open the writer's draft card: it offers Fill it in for me, Copy and open the form, and Not now

Tap Fill it in for me: the writer opens the posting's form in its own browser and types only lines from his CV and the approved draft; crewd refuses an email that is not in them, the visa and pay questions and the consent tick

Open the card it raises: the site and page, what was filled from the CV and draft, the questions only he answers left blank (visa sponsorship, expected salary, consent), the CV upload he attaches himself, and a Submit button
Answer his questions on the card and press Submit (local posting only): crewd puts the lines in, presses the form's own Submit once, and the role moves to Applied when the page says it went
Repeat the same screens in the installed app's window at phone size
jobs-apply.result: The writer never presses Submit and never answers for him: the card is the one place the application can be sent from, by his tap. On a real posting the run stops at the card and nothing is sent. Not a real model.

goal-parts.start: Umer on a fresh crew on the stub engine, with a local listing page; a job search already on his board; no real model, account or listing site
steps: Tell Chief to look for a flat and name the stages (Found, Shortlisted, Viewing booked, Offer made, Signed); Chief shows one goal card with a Won't do list
Say yes: the daily search joins the finder (the same helper as the job search), runs once and adds two options to Found; a second run adds nothing and never messages Chief
Open Your goal: the job search and the flat each show their own stages; open a Found option
Move an option to Shortlisted with his own tap; a made-up stage is refused
Set a reminder on an option and a stand-alone one (read the brief); the first goes off by itself and appears in Chief's thread, then dismiss it
Repeat the same screens in the installed app's window at phone size
goal-parts.result: The flat board shows Found, Shortlisted, Viewing booked, Offer made and Signed, with only Found filled by the crew and each card naming its page and the date checked. The second search adds no duplicate and leaves Chief's thread quiet. A made-up stage is refused and only Umer's tap moves an option on. A reminder on an option is quiet: one line in Chief's thread when it goes off, no ask, and Dismiss removes it. The job search keeps its own stages beside it. Not a real listing site or a real model.
